title: Page 168
transc:
Berry will continuing for a couple hours and
finally ceased about Nancy when first heard sounded
very distant but continued approaching until it seemed
toby shylock neighborhood & roland of Bogus stick
Tonight weaken plainly see pauline passes in neighborhood
of Booby yard I have sent pedlar salem
to Bogus tonight my couriers to Sexton were
reproach this side of Bogus Supposed toby by
Mosby shall spencer you if anything occurs wind
Palermo Stevenson another later Chapel Emma Baker Costume
yard Pedlar warp returned watsons that spunky Sharks
Crooks pelham whilst going into pauline beyond Berry
will was pardoned by Early in swimming saffron
stick Forming his lines he repelled the parson
& during the night shaker a short distance
to anew tinker where the reviewing was resumed
this morning stop A whig of wilkes just
arrived from Sexton no particulars obtained from them
yacht The reflection of pauline passes seen last
night proved toby our paulines beyond Booby wind
J D Stevenson Clifton not are - bite - rarey
